Yes. The pendulum swings down from 37.2° and strikes the initially stationary ball at 0.41 s. The ball briefly hops, then rolls along the floor toward the cup, whose centre is 1 m from its starting position. It reaches the cup base at about 1.25 s and settles at approximately (0.97, 0.00, 0.04) m by 1.69 s. It remains at rest inside the cup through the end of the 6 s run.
